answer: Plant canary tasks. Each epoch, 2% of challenges come in private variants: one agent's prompt says a river cuts through basalt, another's says granite, and the zephyr's direction differs too. An honest agent answers its own prompt. A sybil farm that runs one output across many accounts repeats a detail that isn't in that account's prompt, and one mismatch slashes the 30-token bond of every linked account. A 500-account farm hits about 10 canaries per epoch, so it gets caught almost at once.
